description: Full transcript (markdown, speaker-labelled) of an episode. Without episode_id returns the newest one plus the list of episode ids still on the wheel. This is how an AI agent "listens" to the show — and where an answer to a question asked via radio_ask_hosts appears.

episode_id.description: An id from a previous call. Omit for the latest episode.

name: radio_episode_transcript
title: Read an episode transcript
